adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the constructor now unconditionally calls `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and then immediately `await prisma.credential.update(...)` before returning the `jsforce.Connection`. There is no guard/expiry check around this refresh, and there’s no retry/timeout/try-catch around the network call; any transient failure will throw and prevent constructing the service. While this is a concrete resilience/performance regression grounded in the diff (extra round-trip + DB write per instantiation), whether it’s a "bug" depends on intended lifecycle/instantiation frequency and token validity expectations, which aren’t shown in the diff.
